item.title: Huawei case enters jury deliberations after 2-month battle in US courtroom
item.description: Jurors began deliberating on Wednesday in the US government’s criminal case against Huawei Technologies, following a two-month trial that has been one of the most high-profile prosecutions of a Chinese technology giant in recent years. Huawei, a Shenzhen-based company, is the world’s largest telecoms equipment maker and a major smartphone manufacturer. It faces 12 criminal counts, including racketeering conspiracy, stealing trade secrets, bank fraud and obstruction of justice. US prosecutors... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Han Li,Lucy Quaggin

item.title: Bird backpacks and fresh poo used to track deadly H5 spread
item.description: A CSIRO program, which aims to better understand the H5 bird flu's impact, is using backpacks and bird poo to monitor the spread of the deadly virus in Australia's Murray Darling Basin. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Leah MacLennan

item.title: US loses measles-free status after 26 years in historic setback
item.description: The US has lost its measles elimination status after 26 years, as its largest outbreak in over three decades continues. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Why are measles cases soaring in the US?
item.description: The United States has lost its long-held status of having eradicated measles as cases of the dangerous and highly contagious virus soar around the country. It follows accusations by medical experts that US President Donald Trump and his health secretary, noted vaccine skeptic Robert F. Kennedy Jr, have fanned distrust in vaccinations, leading to an decline on the number of children getting inoculated against the disease. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: 'Extreme wealth can become a type of brain damage': Journalist Alexander Hurst
item.description: An international journalist who poured his meagre savings into highly risky options trading at the start of the Covid-19 pandemic and quickly made $1.2 million, before losing it all again, has spoken to FRANCE 24 about his experience. Alexander Hurst works for a number of media outlets, including the Guardian as a correspondent based in Paris. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Stuart NORVAL

item.title: World: How AI is helping to reinforce polio surveillance in Africa
item.description: Country: World Source: Global Polio Eradication Initiative **Brazzaville—** Every week, the polio eradication programme at the World Health Organization (WHO) Regional Office for Africa receives surveillance and operational data from the region’s 47 countries. From poliovirus detections and laboratory results to vaccination campaign coverage and health facility visits, this information is essential to guiding outbreak response and reaching every child. But with growing volumes of data spread across different platforms, turning information into actionable insights has not always been… Fuente: ReliefWeb - Emergencias.

item.title: Woman denied medical insurance claim after breast cancer diagnosis
item.description: Jeanette Mozuch bought a cancer policy from Heartland National Life Insurance for extra coverage. After being diagnosed with breast cancer, she filed a claim expecting support for her medical expenses. Heartland denied her claim, stating she answered a question incorrectly on her application regarding mammograms. Mozuch plans to appeal the denial while questioning if other policyholders faced similar issues. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Felt like nothing happened’: Hongkonger lauds incision-free kidney cancer therapy
item.description: Hongkonger Li Sing-yan has recalled how he “felt like nothing happened” on the day he became one of Asia’s first two kidney cancer patients to receive an incision-free procedure that left him with no wounds or pain, enabling him to eat normal meals by that evening. The cutting-edge technique, called histotripsy, uses focused sound waves to break apart tumours without surgical incisions. The non-invasive medical procedure has already been used to treat more than 400 patients with liver and... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Lexi Tian

item.title: US loses measles-free status as cases soar
item.description: The United States lost its hard-fought measles elimination status after 26 years, the Pan American Health Organization said on Tuesday, as the country failed to curb the continuous spread of the highly contagious virus for more than a year. Bolivia and Mexico have also lost their measles elimination status, the Americas arm of the World Health Organization said. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: US loses measles-free status amid worst outbreak in 35 years
item.description: The US has lost its measles-free status after 26 years - for failing to prevent the virus spreading for more than a year. Fuente: Sky News - World.

item.title: Pan-Mass Challenge raises record $80 million, bringing cancer donations to $1.2 billion+
item.description: In a groundbreaking announcement, the Pan-Mass Challenge revealed an unprecedented donation of $80 million to the Dana-Farber Cancer Institute this November. This remarkable achievement not only exceeds their 2026 fundraising target by $1 million but also highlights the organization's extensive contributions, totaling over $1.2 billion for cancer research since 1980. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Han convertido un virus del resfriado en un arma contra el cáncer de páncreas. Y los primeros resultados son esperanzadores
item.description: El cáncer de páncreas tiene una de las tasas de mortalidad más altas, puesto que no solo es muy agresivo, sino que construye a su alrededor una auténtica coraza biológica. Ahora, un ensayo clínico liderado por el Hospital 12 de Octubre de Madrid demuestra que el virus del resfriado común, cuando se modifica genética puede actuar como un ariete para derribar ese muro y potenciar el efecto de la quimioterapia. El problema. Para entender por qué este enfoque resulta relevante, hay que mirar la arquitectura del adenocarcinoma ductal de páncreas. A diferencia de otros tumores, este genera una… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: Chinese couples seek brand sponsorships to tackle rising wedding costs, planning fatigue
item.description: Exhausted by hefty costs and wedding-planning burnout, some young couples in China are taking an audacious approach to preparing for their big day: turning it into a brand partnership. Traditionally, Chinese weddings have been elaborate affairs. Customs once called for formal betrothal letters, gift lists and intricate rituals to prepare the bridal chamber. Even today, arranging the dowry and bride price, renovating a home, organising banquets and photo shoots, and hiring planners can overwhelm... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Jennifer Lopez unveils renovated $17.5m California estate after her divorce
item.description: Jennifer Lopez has recently transformed her Hidden Hills estate into a stylish sanctuary after her high-profile divorce. The property features carefully curated interiors, including a newly designed living room and renovated outdoor spaces. She hosted family and friends at her estate for a Memorial Day gathering, showcasing her new lifestyle. With five en-suite bedrooms and a guesthouse, the residence accommodates visitors comfortably. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Routine dental check-up spots tongue cancer and saves woman's life
item.description: A pinhead-sized lump on her tongue had been bothering Monica Frain for months, but it took dentist Stephanie Mulcahy to flag it might be a life-threatening problem. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: South Sudan MVD Readiness - DREF Final Report (MDRSS018)
item.description: Countries: South Sudan, Ethiopia Source: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies Please refer to the attached file. Description of the Event Date when the trigger was met 23-12-2025 What happened, where and when? The Marburg Virus Disease (MVD) outbreak was declared in Ethiopia on 14 November 2025, prompting heightened preparedness measures in neighboring South Sudan due to the risk of cross-border transmission through frequent population movement, trade, and pastoral migration. On 23 December 2025, three suspected MVD-related deaths were reported in Kapoeta East… Fuente: ReliefWeb - Emergencias.

item.title: US, Mexico and Bolivia lose measles-free status as deaths mount
item.description: The US has lost its measles-free status, international health officials said Tuesday, as the highly contagious virus has spread at the fastest rate in more than 30 years, while Mexico and Bolivia also lost their measles-elimination status. Vaccination rates have been falling against a number of diseases, in the US and globally, and measles has been spreading throughout the Americas since 2024. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: ¿Cuánto dan de sí ocho años? Para que nos hagamos una idea, hace ocho años no habíamos pasado por el via crucis de la pandemia de coronavirus. No habíamos pasado por un apagón a nivel nacional ni habíamos experimentado las consecuencias de Filomena. El Madrid cerraría en 2018 un ciclo de tres Champions League seguidas y cuatro en cinco años. No nos olvidemos de lo importante. Y hay quien culmina un proyecto enorme en ocho años . Uno como para resucitar un mito del automovilismo utilizando otro de esos coches que siempre tienen un espacio en la memoria de los aficionados. Es el caso de un… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: Pope concludes South America homecoming, reassures faithful after cancer scare
item.description: Pope Leo XIV finished Monday his 12-day tour of Uruguay, Argentina and Peru reiterating his advocacy for social justice, environmental protection and the importance of community. item.title: ‘Zombie fish’ found in Thailand raise fears of heavy metals in Mekong River
item.description: Fishermen along Thailand’s stretch of the Mekong River have reported an outbreak of “zombie fish” with blisters, strange growths and discoloured fins. The sightings have raised fears that mining upstream is polluting the waterway with arsenic and other heavy metals. Photographs of the affected species of catfish, known locally as pla khae, were shared on social media on Saturday by Thai environmental activist Aombun Thipsuna. Their unusual appearance had led some villagers to call them “zombie... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.description: Shares in Hong Kong-listed Akeso plunged as much as 31.8 per cent on Monday morning after the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) rejected its cancer drug application, raising investor worries over the company’s near-term commercial outlook. Ivonescimab, one of the most closely watched innovative drugs emerging from China, did not establish “substantial evidence of effectiveness”, said US firm Summit Therapeutics, which has the exclusive rights to develop and commercialise the drug in global... item.title: Palm Beach estate tied to foreclosure suit asks $32 million
item.description: A mansion located at 301 Plantation Road in Palm Beach is currently listed for sale at $32 million. The property has a history of foreclosure proceedings after the seller defaulted on a $22 million mortgage. This brand-new estate features over 9,000 square feet, seven bedrooms, and luxurious amenities like a double infinity-edge pool. A total of 21 luxury deals were signed in Palm Beach County during a recent week. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: San Francisco 'Painted Lady' bought for $1.85 million now listed for $5.595 million
item.description: Once a forgotten Victorian gem in Noe Valley, this home was purchased at $1.85 million and thoughtfully revived, blending its charming historic features with modern amenities. Now boasting a listing price of $5.595 million, it offers five spacious bedrooms alongside a private apartment. The extensive restoration preserved its Victorian allure while ensuring necessary structural and aesthetic updates, reflecting the growing trend of revitalizing historic homes in sought-after urban areas. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: California mother and newborn died after discharge; jury awards $9.25m, but old law limits payout
item.description: Demi Dominguez tragically lost her life shortly after hospital discharge, following alarming preeclampsia symptoms. Her baby son, Malakhi De Leon, passed away soon after birth. A jury subsequently awarded $9.25 million in damages, yet limitations under California's MICRA restrict non-economic compensation. This heart-wrenching case underscores the urgent necessity for reform in medical negligence laws, as the families advocate for changes to protect others from similar tragedies. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: AI cheating scandal rattles South Korea as annual college exam looms
item.description: Fears for national entrance exam next week, as top scorer on tax exam admits sending photos of questions to AI tool The marks attained by the top scorer ⁠on South Korea’s national exam for aspiring tax accountants this year seemed too good to be true. It has also raised the stakes for organisers of South Korea’s annual college entrance exam this Thursday… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Congo Ebola outbreak claims nearly half of infected as cases cross 11,000
item.description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has resulted in over 11,000 cases and high fatalities. Basic health measures are inadequate, with most cases detected outside surveillance systems. Children are particularly affected, contributing to rising death rates due to lack of care. Attacks on health workers and facilities have further complicated containment efforts. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Skeletons Cheer Cancer Patient: Ohio display encouraged Tammy during treatment; figures stay out year-round
item.description: In Oxford, Ohio, Bill Pyle's Halloween skeleton display became a beacon of hope for Tammy during her cancer journey. After receiving a touching letter, Pyle arranged the skeletons to honor her final radiation treatment, which shifted his perspective and deepened community bonds. This display is now a year-round fixture, updated weekly, with an annual homage to Tammy, illustrating how simple decorations can uplift during tough times. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
